0022600016.text: The Celtics (3-1, on a three-game win streak) host the Bulls in the 5th game of Boston's season, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and 4th in the East, with a perfect 3-0 home record. Chicago (1-4, on a three-game losing streak) is 4th in the Central, 3 games back, and 12th in the East, and the Bulls are without Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness), while Jalen Smith (finger) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Boston is also missing Devin Carter (illness), and the Celtics lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 134-99 win in Boston on October 26, following a 2-1 series win over Chicago in 2025-26.
